TABLE.NAME: auth_kabmagic_tokens
TABLE.COMMENT: Login link requests: hashed one-time tokens plus the rows needed for rate limiting

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: User the link was issued to; 0 when the address matched nobody eligible (the row then only counts towards the rate limit)

FIELD.NAME: emailhash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 of the lower-cased address that was entered, for rate limiting

FIELD.NAME: tokenhash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 of the raw token; empty when no link was issued. The token itself is never stored

FIELD.NAME: wantsurl
FIELD.COMMENT: Absolute URL inside wwwroot to open after the login

FIELD.NAME: ip
FIELD.COMMENT: IP address the link was requested from
